details:
I would request a point system for uploading avatars.

When your Account is fresh you have a low amount of points and with playtime they increase...

Now, every avatar in your account cost you such points based on their performance ranking...

a very good or excellent avatar cost low amount of points while a very poor cost alot.

If you run out of points you cannot upload more.

But you can update your already uploaded avatars. Making them more performant giving you back some points since the uploaded avatar will get re-evaluated

Like this you can have many good avatars or a low amount of poor ones.

I think this system would make ppls improve their avatars with time.

It also would generate pressure on avatar creatures to build their avatars correctly and performant.

I know many ppls will hate me for this idea, but i am sick of extremely unperformant avatars where my pc freeze for seconds when their avatars loading in... Thanks!
title: Avatar Upload Point System
